target_material: Lanthanum titanate and lithium lanthanum titanate (LLT)
summary: The study describes the atomic layer deposition (ALD) of lanthanum titanate and lithium lanthanum titanate (LLT) thin films. The process involves combining titanium oxide and lanthanum oxide sub-cycles with a lithium oxide sub-cycle using specific precursors. The films were analyzed for composition and structure, and the results indicate that the ALD process can produce uniform and conformal films suitable for applications in all-solid-state lithium ion batteries.
evidence: The text states that the films were grown by atomic layer deposition (ALD) using TiCl4, water, La(thd)3, ozone, LiOtBu, and H2O as precursors. The deposition temperature was 225 /C14 C. The study also mentions that the films were analyzed by various techniques, including TOF-ERDA, which showed the film composition at saturation conditions as Li0.32La0.30TiOz. The purpose of the study is to demonstrate the ALD of LLT films for use in all-solid-state lithium ion batteries.
